visual_action: The video is a slideshow of still images and screenshots with text overlays. It begins with text claiming Donald Trump knows "nothing" about Project 2025, followed by a screenshot of a purported tweet from Trump making that claim. It then presents a series of counter-points: a photo of Trump with John McEntee, a screenshot of a YouTube video featuring Trump's press secretary in a Project 2025 ad, a screenshot of a web ad for Project 2025 from a Trump-affiliated Super PAC, and a photo of Trump with the president of the Heritage Foundation. The video concludes with a photo of Trump on a golf course with the text "He knows."
